bullets.text: The Spurs have won eight straight to reach 8-2, taking the West Southwest lead from the Rockets, who have lost two straight.
The 76ers lead the East Atlantic at 9-2 on a modest +34 point differential, while the Timberwolves own the NBA's best margin at 8-3.
Four teams sit at 1-8 or 1-9: the Bulls, Bucks, Jazz and Kings, with the Jazz on an eight-game skid.
